checklist.item: Grab bar heights, lengths and positions are dimensioned to the accessibility code in force.
Backing or blocking in the wall is shown, sized for the grab bar load.
checklist.why: A bar screwed to gypsum board pulls out.

checklist.item: Clear space between bar and wall, and clearance above and below, are shown.
Fasteners through tile or a wet-wall membrane are sealed.
checklist.why: Each anchor is a hole in the waterproofing.

checklist.item: Accessory mounting heights (dispensers, mirror, hooks) are in the same detail or referenced.
Bar diameter, finish and model are tagged.
